Q01: SELECT COUNT(*) AS hub_count FROM twxv WHERE c10 = 'CargoLink'
Q02: SELECT c02, c10 FROM tu5q WHERE c16 = 'active' AND c10 >= 2015 ORDER BY c10 DESC, c02 ASC
Q03: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_flights FROM tx7n WHERE c19 = 'cancelled'
Q04: SELECT c02 AS model, MAX(c13) AS max_payload_kg FROM t89v GROUP BY c02 ORDER BY max_payload_kg DESC
Q05: SELECT SUM(c13) AS total_declared_value_usd FROM t89v WHERE c11 = 'delivered' AND c12 = 'pharmaceuticals'
Q06: SELECT T1.c02 AS name, T1.c12 AS country FROM th77 AS T1 JOIN tajj AS T2 ON T1.c01 = T2.c03 WHERE T2.c05 = 45 ORDER BY T1.c02, T1.c12
Q07: SELECT c16 AS status, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count FROM tx7n GROUP BY c16 ORDER BY status
Q08: SELECT c02 FROM tu5q WHERE c01 NOT IN (SELECT c04 FROM tx7n) ORDER BY c02
Q09: SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_fra_departures FROM tx7n WHERE c07 = (SELECT c01 FROM ts53 WHERE c02 = 'frankfurt') AND c19 = 'completed'
Q10: SELECT th77.c02 AS airline_name, COUNT(tx7n.c01) AS completed_flights FROM th77 LEFT JOIN tx7n ON th77.c01 = tx7n.c04 WHERE tx7n.c19 = 'completed' GROUP BY th77.c02 ORDER BY completed_flights DESC, airline_name
Q11: SELECT t1.c01 AS customer_id, t1.c02 AS name, ROUND(SUM(t2.c09), 2) AS total_declared_value_usd FROM th77 t1 JOIN tu5q t2 ON t1.c01 = t2.c04 JOIN tx7n t3 ON t2.c01 = t3.c04 WHERE t3.c19 != 'cancelled' GROUP BY t1.c01, t1.c02 ORDER BY total_declared_value_usd DESC, t1.c01 ASC LIMIT 5
Q12: SELECT c02 AS iata_code, COUNT(*) AS completed_arrivals FROM tx7n WHERE c19 = 'completed' GROUP BY c02 HAVING COUNT(*) > 150 ORDER BY completed_arrivals DESC, iata_code ASC
Q13: SELECT t1.c02 AS iata_code, ROUND(AVG(t2.c16 - t2.c08), 1) AS avg_departure_delay_min FROM ts53 AS t1 JOIN tx7n AS t2 ON t1.c01 = t2.c05 WHERE t2.c19 = 'completed' GROUP BY t1.c02 HAVING COUNT(t2.c01) >= 40 ORDER BY avg_departure_delay_min DESC, t1.c02
Q14: SELECT c01, c02 FROM th77 WHERE c01 NOT IN (SELECT c03 FROM tx7n WHERE c19 != 'cancelled') ORDER BY c01
Q15: SELECT t1.c01 AS customer_id, SUM(t2.c09) AS total_invoiced_usd, SUM(t3.c11) AS total_paid_usd, ROUND(SUM(t2.c09) - SUM(t3.c11), 2) AS outstanding_usd FROM th77 t1 LEFT JOIN tajj t2 ON t1.c01 = t2.c03 LEFT JOIN t8tg t3 ON t2.c01 = t3.c03 WHERE t2.c15 = 'unpaid' OR t3.c12 = 1 GROUP BY t1.c01 ORDER BY outstanding_usd DESC LIMIT 10
Q16: SELECT trhn.c04 AS service_level, COUNT(*) AS connecting_shipments FROM trhn JOIN tx7n ON trhn.c03 = tx7n.c01 WHERE tx7n.c03 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY trhn.c04 ORDER BY trhn.c04
Q17: SELECT t6sc.c02 AS model, ROUND(SUM(tu5q.c09 * t89v.c13) / MAX(tu5q.c10) * 100, 1) AS avg_load_factor_pct FROM t6sc JOIN tu5q ON t6sc.c01 = tu5q.c01 JOIN t89v ON tu5q.c05 = t89v.c01 WHERE tu5q.c16 = 'completed' GROUP BY t6sc.c02 ORDER BY avg_load_factor_pct DESC
Q18: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', tx7n.c04) AS month, SUM(t89v.c13) AS total_kg_flown FROM tx7n JOIN t89v ON tx7n.c01 = t89v.c01 WHERE tx7n.c19 = 'completed' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
Q19: SELECT ts53.c02 AS origin_iata, tu5q.c06 AS destination_iata, COUNT(tx7n.c01) AS completed_flights FROM tx7n JOIN tu5q ON tx7n.c04 = tu5q.c01 JOIN ts53 ON tx7n.c05 = ts53.c01 WHERE tx7n.c19 = 'completed' GROUP BY ts53.c02, tu5q.c06 ORDER BY ts53.c02, destination_iata
Q20: SELECT t02.c01 AS shipment_id, ROUND(t02.c10 - t02.c09, 1) AS hours_late FROM tx7n AS t01 JOIN tu5q AS t02 ON t01.c04 = t02.c01 WHERE t01.c19 = 'delivered' ORDER BY hours_late DESC, t01.c01 LIMIT 10
Q21: SELECT c01 AS customer_id, c02 AS name FROM th77 WHERE c01 NOT IN (SELECT c04 FROM t95g WHERE c05 = 'delivered') AND c04 IN (SELECT c04 FROM tx7n WHERE c09 = 'delivered') ORDER BY c01
Q22: SELECT th77.c01 AS customer_id, MAX(tx7n.c08) AS latest_booking_date, MAX(tx7n.c01) AS shipment_id FROM th77 JOIN tu5q ON th77.c01 = tu5q.c04 JOIN tx7n ON tu5q.c01 = tx7n.c04 GROUP BY th77.c01 ORDER BY th77.c01
Q23: SELECT t1.c01 AS invoice_id, t3.c02 AS customer_name, julianday('2025-12-20') - julianday(t1.c05) AS days_overdue, ROUND(t1.c09 - SUM(t2.c06), 2) AS outstanding_usd FROM tajj AS t1 JOIN t8tg AS t2 ON t1.c01 = t2.c03 JOIN th77 AS t3 ON t1.c03 = t3.c01 WHERE t1.c05 < '2025-12-20' AND t2.c06 < t1.c09 GROUP BY t1.c01, t3.c02 ORDER BY days_overdue DESC, t1.c01 LIMIT 10
Q24: SELECT t11.c11 AS commodity_category, COUNT(DISTINCT t10.c01) AS flown_legs, COUNT(DISTINCT t09.c01) AS incidents, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT t09.c01) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT t10.c01), 4) AS incident_rate FROM tajj AS t01 INNER JOIN t8tg AS t02 ON t01.c01 = t02.c03 INNER JOIN th77 AS t03 ON t02.c04 = t03.c01 INNER JOIN t89v AS t04 ON t01.c02 = t04.c01 INNER JOIN tg6t AS t05 ON t02.c01 = t05.c01 INNER JOIN tx7n AS t06 ON t05.c03 = t06.c01 INNER JOIN tu5q AS t07 ON t06.c04 = t07.c01 INNER JOIN ts53 AS t08 ON t07.c06 = t08.c01 INNER JOIN trhn AS t09 ON t06.c05 = t09.c01 INNER JOIN tpsn AS t10 ON t06.c02 = t10.c02 INNER JOIN tcse AS t11 ON t07.c03 = t11.c03 WHERE t06.c18 = 'flown' GROUP BY t11.c11 ORDER BY incident_rate DESC, commodity_category
Q25: SELECT a.c02 AS airport_a, b.c02 AS airport_b, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.c01 < b.c01 THEN a.c01 ELSE b.c01 END) AS flights_a_to_b, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.c01 > b.c01 THEN a.c01 ELSE b.c01 END) AS flights_b_to_a FROM tx7n a JOIN tx7n b ON a.c01 <> b.c01 AND (a.c06 = b.c05 AND a.c05 = b.c06) WHERE a.c19 = 'completed' AND b.c19 = 'completed' GROUP BY airport_a, airport_b ORDER BY airport_a, airport_b
Q26: SELECT COUNT(*) AS bonded_warehouses FROM ts53 WHERE c07 = 'customs_bonded'
Q27: SELECT c01 AS employee_number, c02 AS first_name, c03 AS last_name FROM t6sc WHERE c08 = 'loadmaster' AND c09 IS NULL ORDER BY c01
Q28: SELECT c05 AS dg_class, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count FROM trhn WHERE c05 = 'dangerous_goods' GROUP BY c05 ORDER BY dg_class
Q29: SELECT c01, c02 FROM th77 WHERE c17 = 'platinum' ORDER BY c01
Q30: SELECT ROUND(SUM(tu5q.c09 * t8tg.c06 / 1000), 1) AS total_co2_tonnes FROM tu5q JOIN tx7n ON tu5q.c01 = tx7n.c04 JOIN t8tg ON tx7n.c01 = t8tg.c02 WHERE tx7n.c19 = 'completed'
Q31: SELECT cancellation_reason, COUNT(*) AS cancelled_flights FROM t95g WHERE cancellation_reason IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cancellation_reason ORDER BY cancelled_flights DESC, cancellation_reason ASC
Q32: SELECT c02 AS iata_code, AVG(c16) AS avg_price_usd_per_litre FROM t875 GROUP BY c02 ORDER BY avg_price_usd_per_litre DESC, iata_code ASC
Q33: SELECT th77.c12 AS customs_country, SUM(t3v5.c10) AS total_duty_usd, SUM(t3v5.c11) AS total_vat_usd, ROUND(SUM(t3v5.c10) + SUM(t3v5.c11), 2) AS total_taxes_usd FROM th77 JOIN t3v5 ON th77.c01 = t3v5.c04 WHERE t3v5.c05 = 'import' AND t3v5.c16 = 'cleared' GROUP BY th77.c12 ORDER BY total_taxes_usd DESC, customs_country ASC
Q34: SELECT th77.c02 AS airline_name, t6sc.c08 AS crew_rank, COUNT(*) AS active_crew FROM th77 JOIN tu5q ON th77.c01 = tu5q.c04 JOIN t6sc ON tu5q.c05 = t6sc.c01 WHERE t6sc.c16 = 'active' GROUP BY th77.c02, t6sc.c08 ORDER BY th77.c02, t6sc.c08
Q35: SELECT t1.c02 AS tail_number, ROUND(SUM(t1.c10 + t1.c11), 2) AS total_maintenance_cost_usd FROM tu5q AS t1 JOIN tm8a AS t2 ON t1.c01 = t2.c04 WHERE t2.c05 = 'completed' GROUP BY t1.c02 ORDER BY total_maintenance_cost_usd DESC, tail_number ASC LIMIT 5
Q36: SELECT th77.c02 AS insurer_name, COUNT(t95g.c01) AS claims, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN tm8a.c05 IN ('approved', 'paid') THEN tm8a.c10 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS total_approved_usd FROM th77 JOIN t95g ON th77.c01 = t95g.c04 JOIN tm8a ON t95g.c01 = tm8a.c03 GROUP BY th77.c02 ORDER BY insurer_name
Q37: SELECT ts53.c01 AS warehouse_code, ts53.c02 AS iata_code, COUNT(t3z7.c01) AS rcs_scans FROM ts53 JOIN t3z7 ON ts53.c01 = t3z7.c04 WHERE t3z7.c06 = 'RCS' GROUP BY ts53.c01, ts53.c02 HAVING COUNT(t3z7.c01) > 150 ORDER BY rcs_scans DESC, warehouse_code ASC
Q38: SELECT tu5q.c02 AS model, SUM(t875.c11 * 100 / t875.c12) AS fuel_kg_per_100km FROM tu5q JOIN tx7n ON tu5q.c01 = tx7n.c04 JOIN t875 ON tx7n.c01 = t875.c03 WHERE tx7n.c19 = 'completed' GROUP BY tu5q.c02 ORDER BY fuel_kg_per_100km DESC, tu5q.c02 ASC
Q39: SELECT th77.c02 AS airline_name, tu5q.c05 AS employee_number, ROUND(SUM(t6sc.c16) / 60, 1) AS block_hours FROM tu5q JOIN t6sc ON tu5q.c01 = t6sc.c04 JOIN th77 ON tu5q.c03 = th77.c01 WHERE t6sc.c08 = 'captain' AND tu5q.c16 = 'completed' GROUP BY th77.c02, tu5q.c05 ORDER BY airline_name, employee_number
Q40: SELECT t6sc.c02 AS model, ROUND(SUM(t8tg.c06 * t8tg.c07 * t8tg.c08) / SUM(t89v.c13 * t89v.c14), 1) AS grams_per_tonne_km FROM t6sc JOIN tu5q ON t6sc.c03 = tu5q.c01 JOIN tx7n ON tu5q.c01 = tx7n.c04 JOIN t89v ON tx7n.c01 = t89v.c01 JOIN t8tg ON t89v.c01 = t8tg.c02 WHERE tx7n.c19 = 'completed' AND t89v.c10 = 'delivered' GROUP BY t6sc.c02 ORDER BY grams_per_tonne_km ASC, t6sc.c02 ASC
Q41: SELECT th77.c17 AS service_level, COUNT(CASE WHEN tx7n.c18 = 'delivered' THEN 1 END) AS delivered_shipments, COUNT(CASE WHEN tx7n.c18 = 'delivered' AND tx7n.c07 > th77.c14 THEN 1 END) AS late_shipments, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN tx7n.c18 = 'delivered' AND tx7n.c07 > th77.c14 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN tx7n.c18 = 'delivered' THEN 1 END), 1) AS late_pct FROM th77 JOIN tx7n ON th77.c01 = tx7n.c05 WHERE tx7n.c18 = 'delivered' GROUP BY th77.c17 ORDER BY th77.c17
Q42: SELECT th77.c12 AS customs_country, COUNT(t3v5.c01) AS cleared_imports, AVG(t3v5.c10 - t3v5.c09) AS avg_clearance_hours FROM th77 JOIN t3v5 ON th77.c01 = t3v5.c04 WHERE t3v5.c15 = 'import' AND t3v5.c16 = 'cleared' GROUP BY th77.c12 HAVING COUNT(t3v5.c01) >= 50 ORDER BY avg_clearance_hours ASC, customs_country ASC
Q43: SELECT t89v.c01 AS shipment_id, t89v.c02 AS awb_number, SUM(CASE WHEN t89v.c13 IS NOT NULL AND (t89v.c13 < t89v.c14 OR t89v.c13 > t89v.c15) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS out_of_range_readings, MAX(CASE WHEN t89v.c13 IS NOT NULL AND (t89v.c13 < t89v.c14 OR t89v.c13 > t89v.c15) THEN ABS(t89v.c13 - LEAST(t89v.c14, t89v.c15)) ELSE 0 END) AS max_deviation_c FROM t89v GROUP BY t89v.c01, t89v.c02 ORDER BY t89v.c01
Q44: SELECT t1.c05 AS root_cause, COUNT(t1.c01) AS incidents, SUM(CASE WHEN t2.c12 IN ('approved', 'paid') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS claims, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN t2.c12 IN ('approved', 'paid') THEN t2.c11 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS total_approved_usd FROM t95g AS t1 LEFT JOIN tm8a AS t2 ON t1.c03 = t2.c03 GROUP BY t1.c05 ORDER BY t1.c05
Q45: SELECT t89v.c02 AS awb_number, ts53.c02 AS destination_iata, t3v5.c15 AS import_status FROM t89v JOIN tx7n ON t89v.c01 = tx7n.c01 JOIN ts53 ON t89v.c06 = ts53.c01 LEFT JOIN t3v5 ON t89v.c01 = t3v5.c01 AND t3v5.c05 = 'import' WHERE tx7n.c19 = 'delivered' AND tx7n.c03 IS NULL ORDER BY t89v.c02
